addendum: Local staging adds R224-R228 and a later-visible broad R219 hygiene package. R224 is a no-patch P43 R204 survival bridge against best-available native 360ppi source. R225 applies an actual Paper 34 tail source-restore patch on R204 and compiles twice to 471 pages, but the source is best-available native 400ppi. R226-R228 are no-patch R225 bridge packages for P19/P20, P17/P18, and P15/P16. The broad R219 hygiene package is a same-number collision with the already registered local R219 bridge: it applies two actual TeX fixes on R204 and compiles to 470 pages. R225 and broad R219 therefore require deliberate reconciliation before either is described as the single next German cumulative base.
reader_surface_note: These are source-audit/control packages, not reader-facing language branches. Do not front them above clean Noether reader PDFs. Preserve caveats and avoid critical-edition/source-closure language.
